tool_schemas.name: authenticate_travel
tool_schemas.description: Authenticates a user and client application using the supplied client credentials, refresh token, grant type, and user name, and returns an access token for calling protected travel and payment endpoints. It refuses requests with missing credentials, an unrecognized grant_type, or a refresh_token that is invalid, expired, or not associated with the given client and user. It also refuses when the provided first/last name does not match the user identity tied to the refresh token.

client_id.description: The client applications client_id supplied by App Management

client_secret.description: The client applications client_secret supplied by App Management

refresh_token.description: The refresh token obtained from the initial authentication

grant_type.description: The grant type of the authentication request. Here are the options: read_write, read, write

user_first_name.description: The first name of the user

user_last_name.description: The last name of the user

tool_schemas.implementation:
_DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0323000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0323000") else "/app/database")
def authenticate_travel(client_id, client_secret, refresh_token, grant_type, user_first_name, user_last_name):
    import json, os, math, random
    _S = json.load(open(os.path.join(_DB, 'state.json'), encoding='utf-8'))
    rnd = random.Random(_S.get("random_seed", 141053))
    access_token = str(rnd.randint(100000, 999999))
    return {"expires_in": 2, "access_token": access_token, "token_type": "Bearer", "scope": grant_type}

tool_schemas.name: book_flight
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new flight booking for the authenticated user using the provided itinerary details and charges the specified credit card, returning the created booking details (including a booking identifier). It refuses requests with an invalid or expired access_token, missing required travel fields, an invalid date format, or non-positive/invalid travel_cost. It also refuses if the card_id does not exist, is not owned by the authenticated user, or cannot be used for the purchase (for example due to insufficient available balance/credit or an incompatible card state).

access_token.description: The access token obtained from the authenticate

card_id.description: The ID of the credit card to use for the booking

travel_date.description: The date of the travel in the format YYYY-MM-DD

travel_from.description: The location the travel is from

travel_to.description: The location the travel is to

tool_schemas.name: cancel_booking
tool_schemas.description: Cancels an existing booking for the authenticated user and returns the updated booking/cancellation result. It refuses requests with an invalid or expired access_token, a booking_id that does not exist, or a booking that is not owned by the authenticated user. It also refuses cancellations when the booking is already canceled or otherwise not in a cancelable state.

access_token.description: The access token obtained from the authenticate

tool_schemas.name: compute_exchange_rate
tool_schemas.description: Converts the given value from a base currency to a target currency and returns the converted amount using the service’s supported currency list. It refuses requests where base_currency or target_currency is not one of the supported currency codes or where value is missing or not a valid number. It also refuses conversions it cannot compute (for example when a rate for the requested pair is unavailable).

base_currency.description: The base currency. [Enum]: USD, RMB, EUR, JPY, GBP, CAD, AUD, INR, RUB, BRL, MXN

target_currency.description: The target currency. [Enum]: USD, RMB, EUR, JPY, GBP, CAD, AUD, INR, RUB, BRL, MXN

tool_schemas.name: contact_customer_support
tool_schemas.description: Submits a customer-support request for a specific booking and returns confirmation that the message was received/queued for assistance. It refuses requests with a missing/empty message or a booking_id that does not correspond to an existing booking. It may also refuse when the booking is not eligible for support contact (for example, not found in an active/supportable state).

message.description: The message to send to customer support

tool_schemas.name: get_all_credit_cards
tool_schemas.description: Returns the list of credit cards registered to the authenticated user. It refuses requests with an invalid or expired access_token. It also refuses when the token does not map to a valid user session or the caller is not authorized to view stored payment methods.

access_token.description: The access token obtained from the authenticate call

tool_schemas.name: get_budget_fiscal_year
tool_schemas.description: Returns fiscal-year budget records, optionally filtered to those modified after lastModifiedAfter and optionally including removed fiscal years when includeRemoved is set. It refuses requests where lastModifiedAfter is present but not in the required UTC timestamp format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS) or where includeRemoved is not a valid boolean-like value. It also refuses when the filter values are inconsistent with what the service can apply (for example, an unparseable date).

lastModifiedAfter.description: Use this field if you only want Fiscal Years that were changed after the supplied date. The supplied date will be interpreted in the UTC time zone. If lastModifiedAfter is not supplied, the service will return all Fiscal Years, regardless of modified date. Example: 2016-03-29T16:12:20. Return in the format of YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.

includeRemoved.description: If true, the service will return all Fiscal Years, including those that were previously removed. If not supplied, this field defaults to false.

tool_schemas.name: get_credit_card_balance
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current balance/available amount information for the specified credit card belonging to the authenticated user. It refuses requests with an invalid or expired access_token or a card_id that does not exist. It also refuses when the specified card is not owned by the authenticated user or is not accessible due to card state restrictions.

access_token.description: The access token obtained from the authenticate

card_id.description: The ID of the credit card

tool_schemas.name: get_flight_cost
tool_schemas.description: Returns the available price quote(s) in USD for a flight based on origin/destination airport codes, travel date, and cabin class. It refuses requests with missing fields, invalid IATA airport codes, an invalid date format, or a travel_class outside the supported set (economy, business, first). It also refuses when it cannot price the requested route/date/class combination (for example, no pricing data available).

travel_from.description: The 3 letter code of the departing airport

travel_to.description: The 3 letter code of the arriving airport

travel_date.description: The date of the travel in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'

travel_class.description: The class of the travel. Options are: economy, business, first.

tool_schemas.name: get_nearest_airport_by_city
tool_schemas.description: Returns the nearest airport for the provided city/location name. It refuses requests with a missing location or a location value not in the supported list. It also refuses when it cannot resolve the location to a known airport within the service’s coverage.

location.description: The name of the location. [Enum]: Rivermist, Stonebrook, Maplecrest, Silverpine, Shadowridge, London, Paris, Sunset Valley, Oakendale, Willowbend, Crescent Hollow, Autumnville, Pinehaven, Greenfield, San Francisco, Los Angeles, New York, Chicago, Boston, Beijing, Hong Kong, Rome, Tokyo

tool_schemas.implementation:
def get_nearest_airport_by_city(location, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0323000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0323000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = datetime.datetime.utcnow()

    def _audit(status, error_code=None):
        rows2 = _load("state.json")
        if not isinstance(rows2, list):
            rows2 = []
        if rows2 and isinstance(rows2[0], dict):
            s = rows2[0]
        else:
            s = {}
            rows2 = [s]
        now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat()
        latency_ms = int((datetime.datetime.utcnow() - t0).total_seconds() * 1000)
        log = s.get("request_log", [])
        if not isinstance(log, list):
            log = []
        log.append({
            "ts": now,
            "endpoint": "get_nearest_airport_by_city",
            "credential": None,
            "status": status,
            "error_code": error_code,
            "latency_ms": latency_ms
        })
        s["request_log"] = log
        s["request_count"] = int(s.get("request_count", 0) or 0) + 1
        s["last_request_at"] = now
        _save("state.json", rows2)

    if not isinstance(location, str) or not location.strip():
        _audit("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "location must be a non-empty string.")

    airport_map = {
        "Rivermist": "RMS",
        "Stonebrook": "OKD",         # closest covered airport code in schema set
        "Maplecrest": "OKD",
        "Silverpine": "RMS",
        "Shadowridge": "CRH",
        "London": "LHR",
        "Paris": "CDG",
        "Sunset Valley": "SFO",
        "Oakendale": "OKD",
        "Willowbend": "BOS",
        "Crescent Hollow": "CRH",
        "Autumnville": "BOS",
        "Pinehaven": "BOS",
        "Greenfield": "ORD",
        "San Francisco": "SFO",
        "Los Angeles": "LAX",
        "New York": "JFK",
        "Chicago": "ORD",
        "Boston": "BOS",
        "Beijing": "PEK",
        "Hong Kong": "HKG",
        "Rome": "CIA",
        "Tokyo": "HND",
    }
    if location not in airport_map:
        _audit("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Unsupported location.")

    code = airport_map.get(location)
    if not code:
        _audit("error", "NOT_FOUND")
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "No airport found for the given location.")

    _audit("ok", None)
    return {"location": location, "nearest_airport": code}

tool_schemas.name: list_all_airports
tool_schemas.description: Returns the catalog of airports the system can use for flight search and booking. It refuses requests that include any unexpected parameters.

tool_schemas.name: purchase_insurance
tool_schemas.description: Purchases the requested insurance type for the specified booking and charges the provided saved credit card, returning the created insurance purchase record/confirmation. It refuses requests with an invalid or expired access token, missing required fields, or an insurance_cost that is not a valid number. It also refuses if the booking_id does not exist or is not owned by the authenticated user, if the card_id is not registered to that user, or if the booking is in a state where insurance can’t be added (for example already canceled).

access_token.description: The access token obtained from the authenticate

insurance_type.description: The type of insurance to purchase

card_id.description: The ID of the credit card to use for the

tool_schemas.name: register_credit_card
tool_schemas.description: Registers a new credit card to the authenticated user and returns the saved card record (including its identifier for future charges). It refuses requests with an invalid or expired access token, missing required fields, or malformed card details (for example an invalid expiration_date format or an invalid card_verification_number type). It also refuses cards that are expired or otherwise fail basic validation.

access_token.description: The access token obtained from the authenticate method

expiration_date.description: The expiration date of the credit card in the format MM/YYYY

tool_schemas.name: retrieve_invoice
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves and returns an invoice associated with the authenticated user’s purchase, for either a booking_id or an insurance_id. It refuses requests with an invalid or expired access token, with neither identifier provided, or with identifiers that don’t exist or aren’t owned by the authenticated user. It also refuses ambiguous requests that provide conflicting identifiers that don’t refer to the same underlying purchase context.

access_token.description: The access token obtained from the authenticate

tool_schemas.name: set_budget_limit
tool_schemas.description: This tool belongs to the travel system, which allows users to book flights, manage credit cards, and view budget information. Tool description: Set the budget limit for the user Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

access_token.description: The access token obtained from the authentication process or initial configuration.

budget_limit.description: The budget limit to set in USD

tool_schemas.name: travel_get_login_status
tool_schemas.description: Returns whether the provided access token is currently authenticated/active for the travel service. It refuses requests with a missing, invalid, or expired access token, and it refuses any request that includes fields other than access_token.

access_token.description: The access token obtained from the authenticate call

tool_schemas.name: verify_traveler_information
tool_schemas.description: Validates the provided traveler identity details and returns a verification result indicating whether the information is acceptable for booking. It refuses requests with missing fields or values that don’t meet basic format requirements (for example date_of_birth not in YYYY-MM-DD). It also refuses details that fail internal consistency checks (such as obviously invalid dates or passport numbers that don’t meet expected structure).

first_name.description: The first name of the traveler

last_name.description: The last name of the traveler

date_of_birth.description: The date of birth of the traveler in the format YYYY-MM-DD

passport_number.description: The passport number of the traveler
